question: Explain electric current in terms of the movement of charges. Distinguish among conventional current, electron flow, direct current, and alternating current.

question: Explain why an ammeter has very low resistance and is connected in series, while a voltmeter has very high resistance and is connected in parallel. Discuss the effects of incorrect connection.
